cases.name: Kelly Ann FitzGerald Caples
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a graduate of North Carroll High School in 1981. She was an avid music lover and a fan of Nascar, but most of all she loved her family."
cases.narrative: She had multiple defensive wounds on the fingers of both of her hands and had been “bludgeoned in the forehead (consistent with hammer strikes) which shattered her cranium. She also had puncture wounds to her chest. Investigators found her at the base of the stairs on the first floor of her home “in a pool of bright red, liquid blood,” and found a hammer and what was described as a 7-inch kitchen knife in proximity.
